mapper.select: SELECT id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, character_id, version_number, reference_asset_id, reference_scope, language, accent, voice_description, delivery_baseline, status, locked_at FROM character_voice_profiles WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT cvp.id, cvp.row_version, cvp.created_at, cvp.updated_at, cvp.character_id, cvp.version_number, cvp.reference_asset_id, cvp.reference_scope, cvp.language, cvp.accent, cvp.voice_description, cvp.delivery_baseline, cvp.status, cvp.locked_at FROM character_voice_profiles cvp JOIN characters c ON c.pinned_voice_profile_id = cvp.id WHERE c.id = #{characterId}

SELECT id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, character_id, version_number, reference_asset_id, reference_scope, language, accent, voice_description, delivery_baseline, status, locked_at FROM character_voice_profiles WHERE character_id = #{characterId} ORDER BY version_number ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE character_voice_profiles SET reference_asset_id = #{referenceAssetId}, reference_scope = #{referenceScope}, language = #{language}, accent = #{accent}, voice_description = #{voiceDescription}, delivery_baseline = #{deliveryBaseline}, status = #{status}, locked_at = #{lockedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}
